subject: California SB 813 and AB 1405 enacted — independent AI verification registry

metrics.headline: California SB 813 and AB 1405 enacted — independent AI verification registry
metrics.body_excerpt: California's SB 813 and AB 1405 are now law, creating a state framework for independent verification organizations and a registry of AI auditors. First US statutory machinery for certified third-party model testing, full audit regime phases in later this decade.
